# landerpilot-mcp

`landerpilot-mcp@0.2.3` is a universal Node.js MCP distribution for LanderPilot. It packages a stdio-to-cloud bridge, a local helper server, multi-client setup/doctor commands, site blueprints, and LanderPilot generation skills.

## Cloud bridge

`cloud-proxy.mjs` forwards stdio MCP calls to:

```text
https://landerpilot.com/api/mcp
```

It reads `LANDERPILOT_API_KEY` and optional `LANDERPILOT_MCP_URL`. `landerpilot_connection_status` performs a real remote `listTools` request. A rejected connection or remote call clears the cached session so the next request can reconnect.

## Installation and configuration

Persistent configuration uses a global package installation:

```bash
npm install -g landerpilot-mcp
landerpilot-mcp-setup --client cursor
landerpilot-mcp-doctor --client cursor
```

The setup command refuses npm temporary-cache installs because generated configs contain an absolute path to `cloud-proxy.mjs`.

Supported clients:

- Trae: user-level config by default; compatibility commands are `landerpilot-trae-setup` and `landerpilot-trae-doctor`.
- Cursor, Claude Desktop, Codex, CodeWhale, OpenCode: user-level config by default.
- Generic, Claude Code, VS Code/Copilot: project-level config.

Project and custom targets store a plaintext API Key and are refused unless `--allow-project-secret` is explicit. An explicit `--global-config` override is treated as custom. Setup does not edit `.gitignore` or place old-Key backups beside project/custom configs. Default global configs and their timestamped backups are chmod `0600` where supported.

The official `https://landerpilot.com` origin is trusted by default. A custom HTTPS or loopback endpoint requires both `--url` and `--allow-custom-url`; non-loopback HTTP is always rejected.

Setup reads the API Key from a hidden prompt by default. Command-line `--api-key` is rejected because process arguments and shell history can expose it. Automation may inject `LANDERPILOT_SETUP_API_KEY` into the setup process environment.

OpenCode keeps the V1 `mcp.<name>` shape that is compatible with official V2. If `opencode.jsonc` already exists beside the default `opencode.json`, setup uses the JSONC file and edits only the target node, preserving comments and trailing commas.

## Local MCP

`server.mjs` exposes:

- `list_sites`
- `inspect_site`
- `list_template_slots`
- `prepare_deployment_handoff`
- `get_cloud_mcp_connection`

These tools inspect or generate local handoff data; they do not deploy by themselves.

## Blueprints and data policy

- `affiliate-review-yp` adds exactly one YeahPromos verification meta to every generated page. The default affiliate-review variant adds none.
- `affiliate-review`, `cashback`, and `blog` fail when required real data is missing.
- `blog` requires at least one post with title, content, and date. Explicit `demo_mode: true` permits only one placeholder post.

## Distribution checks

```bash
npm test
npm run pack:check
npm run verify:distribution
npm run publish:check
```

`verify:distribution` packs the tarball, performs `npm install -g <tarball> --prefix <temp>`, runs MCP/config smoke tests from the installed prefix, and removes the tarball in `finally`.

`publish:check` queries the exact `landerpilot-mcp@0.2.3` registry version and runs `npm publish --dry-run`. It exits with status `2` after successful checks when npm authentication is missing. `prepublishOnly` runs tests, pack checks, and distribution verification without recursively invoking `publish:check`.

## File map

- `README.md`: human-facing overview and security notes.
- `llms.txt`: concise AI-readable summary.
- `llms-full.txt`: this expanded summary.
- `cloud-proxy.mjs`: cloud stdio bridge.
- `server.mjs`: local helper MCP.
- `scripts/shared/agent-config.mjs`: target resolution, JSONC merge, secret policy, permissions.
- `scripts/shared/remote-session.mjs`: retryable remote session and status probe.
- `scripts/setup-agent.mjs`: universal setup.
- `scripts/doctor-agent.mjs`: universal doctor.
- `scripts/verify-distribution.mjs`: real tarball installation smoke test.
- `docs/`: install, student, teacher, Agent, Windows, and deployment guides.
- `skills/landerpilot/`: LanderPilot skill and local generation tools.
- `blueprints/`: site blueprint producers.
- `generators/`: shared Astro/site generation helpers.
